original_title: La Sinfonía de los Bichos raros
overview: In the extraordinary neighborhood of Los Matorrales, hidden behind a massive wall in the city, lives Macha, a kind-hearted and dreamy cockroach who sings while helping at her father's legume shop. Everything changes when the business faces imminent closure. To save the store, protect her community, and fulfill her dream of becoming a singer, Macha convinces her group of friends—fellow misfits like a spider, a centipede, a vulture, and an opossum—to form a band of "weird bugs" and enter a human reality TV show. Through music, humor, and adventure, they discover the true power of friendship and self-acceptance.
